_about: Shared InfiniBot plugin showcase content (KinglyVault, infinibotos.com, cloud.infinibotos.com). Facts come from the plugin manifests + the public registry (cloud.infinibotos.com/api/marketplace/index.json). NO prices here: prices, versions, icons and screenshots are read from the registry (at build time for static pages, at runtime on KV). Media = hosted course lessons on infinibot-media.netlify.app. Updated 2026-10-27.

reel.caption: 34-second overview: the plugins that plug into InfiniBot

plugins.name: FlyPic
plugins.outcome: Make AI images and videos (including motion swap) from InfiniBot chat or FlyPic's own studio.
plugins.forWho: Creators, faceless-content operators and designers who want their agents to generate visuals on their own AI keys.
capabilities: FlyPic's studio embedded 1:1: image + video, references, aspect and quality
Agent tools: generate, wait for the job, reuse an item as a reference
Your FlyPic library inside InfiniBot: filter, download, favorite, reuse
steps: Install FlyPic from the marketplace (or unlock it with CEO).
Click Connect FlyPic and approve on flypic.ai. Tokens are stored encrypted.
Ask an agent for an image or a video, or open the Studio page and generate yourself.
requirements: A FlyPic account (connect in one click or paste a FlyPic API token)
Your own AI provider keys in FlyPic: it runs on them, not on InfiniBot credits
Agent access follows your FlyPic plan's MCP & API access

faqs.q: Do I pay InfiniBot credits for generations?
faqs.a: No. FlyPic runs on the AI provider keys in your FlyPic account.

faqs.q: Can I use it on InfiniBot Cloud?
faqs.a: Yes. The registry lists FlyPic as available on InfiniBot Cloud.

faqs.q: Where do I learn motion swap?
faqs.a: The Content Studio + FlyPic course has a Motion Swap lesson and a capstone that builds a motion-swap promo.

examples.title: Motion Swap: put your character into any motion

plugins.name: Content Studio
plugins.outcome: Run your social content like a studio: a page per channel, scripts, reel intelligence and a CMO agent.
plugins.forWho: Anyone posting to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or LinkedIn who wants ideas, scripts and posting in one pipeline.
capabilities: One content page per channel with scripts, ideas, goals and brand voice
Reel library with metrics, transcripts and viral-format scoring
CMO, Content Director, Scriptwriter, Brand Designer and Video Editor agents
steps: Install Content Studio from the marketplace.
Create a page for each channel and connect Instagram (Graph API token) if you want live stats.
Let the CMO agent draft scripts from your research and saved viral examples, then queue posts.
requirements: Instagram Graph API token for live follower and reach stats (optional)
The reel pipeline (download, transcription, scoring) needs a self-hosted install with Python, gallery-dl and Whisper

faqs.a: It runs the pipeline from idea to queued post. Live posting to phones goes through Droid Swarm with an approval step.

faqs.q: What happens if I turn it off?
faqs.a: Every page hides and background sync stops. Your data stays where it is.

demo.title: Content Studio: set up your pipeline

examples.title: From library to posted: the posting queue

plugins.name: Droid Swarm
plugins.outcome: Run a rack of Android phones from one console: devices, accounts, workflows and egress routes.
plugins.forWho: Social media operators who run real accounts on real phones and want one console with human checkpoints.
capabilities: Enrol phones over USB or wireless debugging, watch and drive the live screen
Assign accounts to phones; secrets never enter the database
Scheduled workflows, one egress route per phone and a full audit log
steps: Install adb on the computer running InfiniBot, then enable the plugin.
Enrol a phone with the companion APK or wireless debugging and pin it to your tailnet.
Import an account, bind it to a phone and approve your first post from Content Studio.
requirements: Self-hosted InfiniBot (not available on InfiniBot Cloud)
One or more Android phones and adb on the host computer
Optional: Tailscale, Fly.io and Cloudflare for remote phones and egress
plugins.responsibleUse: Automating social accounts can break a platform's terms of service and can get accounts restricted or banned. Use your own accounts, respect each platform's rules and limits, and keep a human approval on every post. The course's Platform Rules lesson covers the real risks.

responsibleLesson.title: Platform Rules, Real Risk and Responsible Use

faqs.q: Does it work on InfiniBot Cloud?
faqs.a: No. It controls phones on your own network with adb, so it needs a self-hosted InfiniBot.

faqs.q: Will it get my accounts banned?
faqs.a: It can if you break a platform's rules. Droid Swarm adds limits and approval steps, but you are responsible for how accounts are used.

demo.title: What Droid Swarm is (and what it refuses to do)

examples.title: Connect your phones: pairing and live control

plugins.name: HoloCanvas
plugins.outcome: Turn reports into narrated, shareable walkthroughs on an infinite canvas.
plugins.forWho: Agencies and consultants who present proposals, audits and client walkthroughs.
capabilities: Build a walkthrough from a report or pasted markdown in one click
Bake per-scene narration audio
Share a link or download a single-file HTML export
steps: Install HoloCanvas from the marketplace.
Pick a report (or paste markdown) and build a walkthrough.
Narrate it, then share the link or the HTML file with your client.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud

faqs.q: Do share links break if I turn the plugin off?
faqs.a: No. The canvas runtime is part of InfiniBot core; turning the plugin off only hides the library.

plugins.name: Robovoice
plugins.outcome: Give your agents a voice: characters, a speech pipeline and live calls.
plugins.forWho: Businesses that want an AI receptionist or voice agents that answer with InfiniBot's brain.
capabilities: Robovoice becomes InfiniBot's voice backend for every agent
Give each agent its own Robovoice character
Edit the speech-to-text, model and text-to-speech pipeline from InfiniBot
steps: Install Robovoice from the marketplace.
Link this install to your self-hosted Robovoice stack or Robovoice cloud.
Map agents to characters and take a call.
requirements: A Robovoice self-hosted stack or a Robovoice cloud account
On Robovoice cloud, calls use your Robovoice wallet credits; self-hosted has no metering

faqs.a: InfiniBot itself: a gateway agent or a CLI agent, streamed back for low-latency speech.

demo.title: Voice receptionist: answer, qualify, take the message

plugins.name: Business & Agency
plugins.outcome: Run the business side from your AI OS: HQ, clients, pipeline and agencies in one place.
plugins.forWho: Freelancers and agencies who want CRM, invoicing and a sales pipeline next to their agents.
capabilities: Business HQ with today's focus and decision-ready items
Client CRM with invoicing and payment links
Sales pipeline, lead capture and funnels
steps: Install Business & Agency from the marketplace.
Fill in your business profile and connect Whop, Stripe or Square (write-only keys).
Add clients and leads, and let the business agents brief you each day.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud

faqs.q: Is my data deleted if I turn it off?
faqs.a: No. Pages and business agents hide; your data stays exactly where it is.

plugins.name: Products
plugins.outcome: Run inventory and product strategy from one focused workspace.
plugins.forWho: Sellers of physical or digital products who track stock, pricing and which products to back.
capabilities: Catalog: SKU, price, cost, stock, media and vendors
Portfolio: validation stage, owner, target customer and revenue model
Product cards on Business HQ when Business & Agency is on
steps: Install Products from the marketplace.
Add catalog rows (they sync with Notion through the Databases system).
Track each product's validation stage and next decision in the Portfolio.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud

plugins.name: InfiniCode
plugins.outcome: Mission control for your servers: a live mesh map, fleet hardware and maintenance runs.
plugins.forWho: Developers and agencies who host client sites or servers.
capabilities: Live mesh map of every node, agent and sector
CPU and memory per server, grouped by site
Queue a maintenance run on any node
steps: Install InfiniCode from the marketplace.
Run the infinicode CLI on each server (or use an HTTPS push token on InfiniBot Cloud).
Watch the fleet and queue maintenance from the panel.
requirements: The infinicode CLI on each server you want to see

learn.title: Plugins: unlock in KinglyVault, install in InfiniBot

plugins.name: Infinitrade
plugins.outcome: The Infinitrade market command center for TradeLocker: terminal, journal, scanner and research.
plugins.forWho: TradeLocker traders who want their journal, scanner and research next to their agents.
capabilities: Trading terminal, journal, scanner, signals and economic calendar
Analyst agent with live trade, chart and journal panels in chat
Read-only by default; orders need a separate permission and a typed confirmation
steps: Install Infinitrade from the marketplace.
Connect your TradeLocker account (read-only by default).
Open Market Command and ask the analyst agent about your journal.
requirements: A TradeLocker account
plugins.responsibleUse: Trading carries risk. Infinitrade does not give financial advice.

plugins.name: Solatrix
plugins.outcome: A Solana command deck: charts, wallets, copy engine and on-chain intelligence.
plugins.forWho: Solana traders who want agents with strict, policy-controlled access.
capabilities: Terminal with candles, token search and route comparison
Portfolio and wallets with encrypted keys and transfer previews
Agent access levels from Off to trade-with-approval, with hard limits
steps: Install Solatrix on a self-hosted InfiniBot.
Add a wallet; agent access starts Off.
Choose an access level and set limits before any agent trades.
requirements: Self-hosted InfiniBot (coming soon to InfiniBot Cloud)
plugins.responsibleUse: Trading carries substantial risk. Solatrix is not financial advice.

plugins.name: OmniClinic
plugins.outcome: A research workspace for clinicians and students: a medical feed, cited briefings and clinic databases.
capabilities: Feed of papers, trials and drug-safety notices from public sources
Ask a question, get a cited briefing
Your own tables for conditions, drugs, cases and protocols
steps: Install OmniClinic from the marketplace.
Pick your specialties for the intelligence feed.
Ask the research engine a question and save what matters to your databases.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud
plugins.responsibleUse: OmniClinic is a study and research tool, not clinical decision support. InfiniBot Cloud is not a HIPAA-covered service.

plugins.name: Discipline
plugins.outcome: Plan your day in time blocks and let your agents' finished work check the boxes.
plugins.forWho: Anyone who drifts and wants a planner that sees the work actually done.
capabilities: Time blocks with a live now-line
Agent runs and tasks logged against the active block
Scores, streaks and Telegram alerts
steps: Install Discipline.
Lay out your day or apply a template.
Work; finished agent runs complete your blocks.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud

plugins.name: Whiteboard
plugins.outcome: Sketch and diagram on a live canvas your agents can draw on too.
plugins.forWho: Anyone mapping ideas, flows or architecture with an agent.
capabilities: Live Excalidraw canvas
Agents draw shapes, connectors and layouts
Saved boards and templates
steps: Install Whiteboard.
Open a board.
Ask an agent to diagram your flow.
requirements: Works on self-hosted InfiniBot and InfiniBot Cloud

plugins.name: Part Scan
plugins.outcome: Scan a physical part with your camera and get a measured, textured 3D model.
capabilities: Guided camera capture on a printed calibration mat
Measure dimensions in millimetres
Export GLB and STL
steps: Install Part Scan.
Turn on the worker on a machine with a supported NVIDIA GPU.
Capture, reconstruct and measure.
requirements: 3D reconstruction needs a self-hosted install with Docker and an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 12.8)

learn.title: Plugins: unlock in KinglyVault, install in InfiniBot

plugins.name: Discord Community Manager
plugins.outcome: Run your Discord with InfiniBot: welcome and verification, intake, tickets and moderation with approvals.
plugins.forWho: Community owners and coaches running a Discord server.
capabilities: Welcome, verification and an intake questionnaire with lead scoring
Ticket threads and scheduled posts
Moderation with an approval gate for bans, mass DMs and @everyone
steps: Connect your Discord bot to InfiniBot.
Run the guided setup wizard on the /community dashboard.
Review approvals before any ban, mass DM or @everyone goes out.
requirements: A Discord server and a Discord bot
Included with InfiniBot, not sold separately: check that your InfiniBot shows the Community page

plugins.name: Browser Relay extension
plugins.outcome: Let agents work in your own logged-in Chrome, one tab you grant at a time.
plugins.forWho: Anyone whose work lives in web apps their agents need to use.
capabilities: Agents act in tabs you explicitly grant, or tabs they create
No cookies, passwords or storage are exported to agents
Page text is treated as data, never as instructions
steps: Install the InfiniBot Browser Relay extension in Chrome.
Pair it with a one-time code.
Grant the current tab, then ask an agent to do the task.
requirements: Google Chrome
A local InfiniBot gateway (the relay is loopback-only)
